analysis.reason: 직전 매수 판단(9/17) 이후 4거래일 연속 상승 추세 유지. RSI 55.7 → 58.2 상승하며 과매도 구간 탈출 확인. MACD 히스토그램 0.0858 → 0.1114 개선되며 상승 모멘텀 강화. 5일 저가 $182.08이 20일 저가 $178.82 대비 높아 Higher Low 패턴 형성. 현재가 $189.60은 SMA5 $185.92, SMA20 $185.37, SMA50 $183.12, SMA100 $181.72 모두 상회하며 강세 정렬 유지. 주봉 RSI 63.5로 강세 구간 진입. analysis.reasonEn: The uptrend has been maintained for 4 consecutive sessions since the previous buy signal (9/17). RSI confirmed exit from oversold territory, rising from 55.7 to 58.2. MACD histogram improved from 0.0858 to 0.1114, strengthening upward momentum. The 5-day low of $182.08 is higher than the 20-day low of $178.82, forming a Higher Low pattern. The current price of $189.60 is above SMA5 ($185.92), SMA20 ($185.37), SMA50 ($183.12), and SMA100 ($181.72), maintaining bullish alignment. Weekly RSI is at 63.5, entering bullish territory. Although ADX is low at 9.5, indicating weak trend strength, daily, weekly, and 4-hour charts are all aligned in an upward direction. A stop-loss of 1.3x ATR (1.81% of current price) allows for a risk-reward ratio of 1.5 or higher.
